brief:
A Palestinian boy was injured on Tuesday by Israeli forces' live gunfire during a raid on al-Fara'a refugee camp, south of Tubas in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported citing Wafa news.

The incident occurred as Israeli forces conducted operations in the camp. No further details about the boy's condition or the circumstances of the shooting were immediately available.
dek: Palestinian boy shot by Israeli gunfire during raid on al-Fara'a refugee camp A Palestinian boy was injured on Tuesday by Israeli forces’ live gunfire during a raid on al-Fara'a refugee camp, south of Tubas in the occupied West Bank, Wafa news reported.
title: Israeli forces shoot Palestinian boy during al-Fara'a raid
